19431.overview:
Touch Racing Nitro is a racing game like no other.
You will drive, drift, jump, launch nitros and fly over your opponents!
3 DIFFERENT TOURNAMENTS AND RACING ENVIRONMENTS
Hone your Touch Racing skills in the Indoor Cup.
Master the 4x4 monster trucks of the Off-Road Cup, or for the speed lovers push your super car to the limit in the Supertrax Cup!
UP TO 12 AWESOME VEHICLES
An impressive rage of visually customizable and unlockable vehicles. Including Buggies, 4x4's, Monster Trucks, and Super Cars
UP TO 18 CHALLENGING TRACKS
A huge range of unlockable tracks that will require different racing styles, and vehicles to master
AMAZING 3D RACING VISUALS
Sweeping Camera Angles, and realistic impacts
make for an immersive racing experience
2 EXCITING GAMES MODES
Tournament or Time Trial where you can race against the clock or your Ghost to really master your lap times and race lines

24824.overview: TETRIS’ iconic blocky shapes are just as effective at occupying every spare thought when you’re not playing as they were when they debuted in 1984. As the times have changed, so too has TETRIS itself, becoming more visually striking while retaining that classic infectious gameplay.

128151.overview:
Sister Angelika is not your average nun: she has purple hair, carries a large gun and a larger scythe, and spends her days fighting zombies. The town of Jalombe is under attack by such zombies, and she has been summoned to help exterminate them. Together with Father Richiardo at the monastery, she must find and destroy the source of the outbreak before Jalombe is destroyed.

Twin Blades is a scrolling action game where the player must slaughter waves of zombies as they spring up from the ground, using both a variety of different guns and a very large scythe. Killing zombies nets the player zombie hearts, which can be exchanged at the monastery for weapon and power upgrades, including new guns, more health, and even new moves. There are several types of zombies, some of which are resistant to certain attacks, and every so often a much larger, more difficult boss creature will appear.

The player can freely travel between open areas, and as stages are played, night will fall, which will cause zombie swarms on other stages to replenish and strengthen. In addition to the main story mode, there is also a survival mode where the player must survive 31 days against endless swarms of zombies.

128152.overview:
The Treasures of Montezuma is another rendition of Bejeweled which has players solving "match 3" puzzles while following a non-interactive adventure storyline.

The objective during the tile matching games is to collect all of the sparkling gems in a level before the time runs out on the ticking pocket watch. The number needed for the level is displayed above the main grid. Swap one stone at a time by choosing a pair, which trade places with a click, slowly eliminating all those which contain gemstones. The entire board can be shuffled twice and hints can be purchased for the cost of points.

The number of gems needed to clear a stage increases by increments of five for each level, maxing out at 200. Therefore, the player needs to work much faster and wiser in later levels to get all of the gems. Luckily there are power-ups that are activated with the golden stars earned when each level is solved. Aztec statue totems in six colors and other modifiers take action in the level when two identical color tile matches are done by the player. The Fire Totem (red) bombs bunches of tiles, for example, while the Time Totem (orange) adds time to the countdown clock.

129539.overview:
Thundering into the unknown at breakneck speed, are you agile enough to negotiate the perils of Trailblazer?
Roll left and right to avoid the cracks and be careful not to fall off the edge of the path as you go.
Be sure to identify and avoid the special tiles which will speed you up and slow you down, block your path or make you jump automatically.
Determination, speed and dexterity are the key assets needed to complete Trailblazer successfully.

129540.overview:
Top Gun is a free-flying air combat shooter based on the film. In Top Gun, players enroll in the Top Gun Academy as Maverick with their Radio Information Officer Goose to go up against the best for Top Gun honors. Following graduation, players fly into the danger zone with fellow US Navy pilots over the Indian Ocean, where they shoot down enemy fighter jets, defend and attack bases and engage in large-scale dogfight battles.

Top Gun features 7 gameplay modes, 2 single and 5 multiplayer. In Campaign Mode, players first learn the ropes at the academy and progress to active duty, teaming up with seasoned flyers to take down enemy jets over the Indian Ocean. In Horde Mode, players show off their flying prowess as they defeat endless waves of increasingly challenging enemies. In online multiplayer, players enlist in the Navy or join their comrades to go head-to-head with up to 15 other opponents in 5 different modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Top Gun, Bombing Run and Capture the Flag.

129541.overview: The gameplay revolves around playing virtual games of Top Trumps based on the National Basketball Association Top Trumps packs. When a match starts, you and your opponent have to fight to gain control of the ball. This decides who takes their turn first. There are time limits to stop a player stalling when choosing their stats. Stats consist of height, free throw percentage, scoring average, assist average, rebound average and number of playoff games played. Every card you win against moves you closer to the basket until you shoot for it.

130393.overview:
Have you ever sat around with your mates discussing the strengths and weaknesses of the 4-4-2 diamond formation? Ever sung (or at least thought) ‘You don’t know what you’re doing!’ as your team’s manager hauls off a favourite player? Think you could do better?

If the answer’s yes, maybe it’s time you took your place in the dugout and tried your hand at This is Football Management™ – the footie management sim, available exclusively on PSP™ and PS3™.

Take your favourite English football team – from any of the top four divisions – and manage your way to eternal glory by winning trophies and claiming league titles. Based on the 2009-10 season with realistic player ratings and data, this is your opportunity to manage a squad of up to 30 players, handle player transfers, deal with injuries, choose tactics and ultimately send out a winning team on that all-important Saturday afternoon.

Easy to pick up and enjoy, This is Football Management™ features a comprehensive ‘Edit Mode’ allowing you to customise proceedings and play how you want to play. And the 2D match engine simulates games, so you can follow each fixture, cheering as the goals go in and making substitutions and tactical decisions as you see fit.

So what are you waiting for? Start your managerial career today: forget about the Special One, it’s time for you to become the biggest gaffer in the game!

130394.overview:
The game is played against asymmetrical opponents where one controls three Tigers and the other controls 15 Goats. Objective of the Tigers is to hunt down the Goats while the Goats attempt to lock the Tigers ability to move. 

Players can choose to be either Tiger or Goat. Both require different playing strategy. The arrangement of pieces, method of play and the rules of capture vary from game to game.

130395.overview:
So you thought you were the ‘pro’ of arcade games? Swot up on your classics!
6 shapes of 4 blocks that drop without ever stopping, lines to complete and make vanish, 3 levels of difficulty, static blocks to hinder your progress and gradually increasing speed... There’s nothing like a bit of quick thinking to get rid of the stress!

134070.overview:
The Terminator for PSP is an explosive top-down all action shooter with an episodic Story Mode and endless Quick Play mode.

The player is Kyle Reese and the objective is to help him progress through several levels to access Skynet's core. Visually, the environment is virtually the same—a desolated area full of wreckage and debris. In addition, an intense soundtrack is included as well as the weapons fire and explosion sound effects.

134167.overview:
In the 3D action game Tehra: Dark Warrior, players meet a variety of brutal, fantastical enemies in aggressive melee combat.

Centuries ago Humans and Urka'h, after years of endless war, agreed to a truce. In order to maintain the truce a warrior was created, half-Human and half-Urka'h. The peace lasted, however, and the warrior was left in stasis. Flash forward to the present day when the Urka'h, without warning, break the truce, and Tehra is hastily revived to investigate the disturbances.

Tehra is handy with a broadsword, and can cast magic by absorbing the souls of slain monsters. By filling up her magic meter entirely Tehra can transform into her Urka'h empowered form, where she turns blue, gets even more naked, and deals additional damage with her attacks.

157901.overview:
Tiny Hawk is a 2D platform game with simple controls and fast arcade feel, where the player must collect the higher number of soda cans in the shortest possible time. The difficulty comes with the impossibility to stop: player is only able to turn and jump.

PlayStation Store version includes new improved graphics and 32 completely different levels.

157902.overview:
Play number-puzzles from the 'Telegraph' like you've never played them before! Discover a whopping 500 puzzles of multiple types. You're in for many hours of game play!

• Sudoku: Classic 9x9 Sudoku grids in 4 levels of difficulty.
• Mini-Sudoku: Easier 6x6 grids.
• Sudoku-X: 9x9 grids in which the diagonals must also be filled with all numbers from 1 to 9.
• Jigsaw Sudoku: 9x9 grids with uncommon box shapes.
• Kakuro: With its handy interface and intuitive controls, this game transfigures the classic pen-and-paper experience.

157903.overview:
Play crossword puzzles from the 'Telegraph' like you've never played them before!

Discover a whopping 500 puzzles of multiple types. You're in for many hours of gameplay!

With its handy interface and intuitive controls, this game transfigures the classic pen-and-paper experience.

Notable features include:

• A huge selection of quick puzzles, cryptic puzzles and general knowledge puzzles!• Registration of best times in the Hall of Fame.• Interactive hints prevent you from being stuck!• Auto-save as you go: you can stop and resume a puzzle at any time!

169482.overview: Play as Colonel Ralf, manuevering your tank and firing its machine guns and cannon. Destroy the enemy army in this arcade classic originally released in 1985, featuring revolutionary controls for its time!

169484.overview: Travel through historical eras such as "The Primitive Age", "The Age of Rome", "The World Wars", "The Age of Wars", and "The Future World" in order to rescue your fellow comrades in this top-down action shooter released by SNK in 1987.

169485.overview: Help your sea otter swim toward victory as you evade hungry killer whales and water hazards galore! As you splash your way toward your goal you will be challenged by dizzying whirlpools, deadly frozen icebergs and sea creatures looking to make you their next meal. But, snag shellfishes and use them as either turbo speed boosts or as projectiles to keep your sea faring foes at bay.

169486.overview: Choose from a wide variety of 100 formations & plays, and challenge the best teams in this American Football game originally released by SNK in 1987.

212672.overview: Taisen Chinchirorin is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Best Media, which was released in Japan in 2011.

212673.overview: Taisen Shogi is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Best Media, which was released in Japan in 2010.
